pairs.subject: metrics-rollups
pairs.evidence: features/dashboard/components/GraphFeedPanel.tsx:72 The feed header renders „{count} z {total} záznamů" with total set to the length of the 12-row window, so it reads „12 z 12 záznamů" over a ledger whose uncapped `considered` count travels on the wire but only surfaces as a footer clause, turning the size limit into an apparent record size.

techniques.evidence: features/dashboard/components/GraphFeedPanel.tsx:72 The producer is right (`considered` is computed before the cap in datedFacts.ts and pinned by publicWire.test.ts), but the consumer's denominator is the list's length. The technique names this failure: render „newest 12 of N", never the length sent. The selected-node match count is likewise a fold over the window only, and nothing marks the cut where the list ends.

features/dashboard/getDashboardData.ts:535 A missing absence_rate is excluded rather than coerced to 0, avgPct is null when no MP carries the figure, and the mean ships with counted/total. isFloor likewise carries the lower-bound status to the tile. Mean-of-ratios composes here because kg-contribution-recompute.ts divides by one chamber-wide sessionDays.

features/dashboard/getDashboardData.ts:239 One loader returns one envelope; summary, histogram, top-5 and attendance all derive from the single getLeaderboardData() result. Layers degrade through explicit per-section slots, and factContracts separates not-attempted (null) from failed; DashboardPage names the dark layers. Failed reads are never memoized.

features/dashboard/getDashboardData.ts:463 The per-company edge read is bounded by MAX_SLICE_CONTRACT_EDGES and the truncation is returned to the surface with its cap and company counts, then rendered in the feed footer. The top-5 is a declared TOP_N beside a link carrying the full chamber count.

features/dashboard/datedFacts.ts:297 The list and both counters come from one selection in one call. Gap against the technique's list-what-could-not-be-read clause: datedFacts.ts:288 drops null-dated rows uncounted, which is legitimate for an open role's missing end date but also silently removes a contract with no signedOn. The core one-selection rule holds; the verdict is conformant on that basis only.

features/dashboard/components/ChamberChart.tsx:40 The only real chart buckets MPs by score band, not time, so there is no grain, zone or effective window. The time-shaped trend is the labelled sample fallback.
features/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx:101 Real data renders no period delta; a repo search of the context for delta/previous/prior hit only RankDelta in MockRankingLedger, the labelled sample ledger.

features/dashboard/getDashboardData.ts:30 This context writes no rollup; it reads figures materialized by the kg-compute writers and holds only a TTL-bounded in-process memo. The stored derivation belongs to the graph-writer context.
